image_description: A close-up view of a polished steel breastplate (cuirass) against a white background. The armor features a raised central ridge, curved anatomical contours for the chest and abdomen, and rolled edges at the armholes and neck. A leather strap with a metal buckle is visible on the right side, indicating attachment mechanisms. The surface shows realistic metallic reflections and minor surface imperfections.
